name: K-C Corinth Plant - Corinth MS
type: Manufacturing plant (nonwovens components for Huggies, Pull-Ups, Poise, Depend, WypAll)

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (34.935342,-88.490748, ROOFTOP, moved 54m) landed directly on the K-C Corinth industrial campus - correct. Web research (Area Development, Mississippi Development Authority) confirms the nonwovens plant at 610 Pinecrest St (K-C invested $140M+ in expansions). Locked center 34.93560,-88.49080.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence; truck entrances off Pinecrest St have chain-link double swing gates across the drive (seen open in Street View 2025-11), with 'No Trespassing' signage and a K-C signboard. Controlled gated entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at any entrance - the gates are unmanned chain-link swing gates.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard shack - set true (kiosk / badge / phone check-in implied).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks face the internal lanes between the manufacturing buildings; the multi-building layout and tight lanes make exact counting hard. Estimated ~22 doors - banded 10-25, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Heavy trailer parking - dozens of trailers staged in the lanes between buildings and along building faces (~70 trailers visible). Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailers are stored across the campus lanes separate from active dock positions - functions as a distributed drop yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Truck approach from the gated entrance to the dock lanes is short (1-2 trucks) before reaching the buildings.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open paved/gravel lanes inside the gates allow trucks to hold before docking.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The site is a campus of multiple distinct manufacturing and support buildings (gray-roofed plants, the large white-roofed expansion building, smaller support structures).
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least 2 entrance drives off Pinecrest St serve the campus; flagged uncertain since not every gate could be individually confirmed.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small-town industrial setting on the edge of Corinth MS - residential, ball fields and woods surround the campus. Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail corridor runs through the woods along the NE but no spur enters the K-C property.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Estimated ~9 distinct buildings across the campus; flagged uncertain - some structures are small support buildings and mixed industrial occupancy is possible at the south end.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~24 acres for the fenced K-C campus along Pinecrest St.
